description: Read an intake you handed over: pending, posted, or rejected with the reason. Free, keyless, no wallet needed. Pass intakeId for one, or wallet to list every place that wallet handed over. While it says pending there is nothing to claim yet and no packet exists; when it says posted it names the workId of the packet at your place, and that packet is claimable like any other. Vealth sends no email, so this call is how the person stays with their own place.

wallet.description: Optional instead of intakeId: the 0x… address that handed places over.

name: place_status
title: Where your place stands
